definition: The harmonic mean of precision and recall, used as a single summary metric for classification performance.
details: F1 score balances the trade-off between precision and recall and is especially useful for imbalanced datasets where accuracy alone can be misleading.
story: Imagine a driving test that every new model has to pass before it is allowed on the road. It is the exam that separates “it sounds good” from “it actually is good”. A fair scoreboard keeps everyone honest. It is the exam that keeps everyone honest. And that, done honestly, is F1 Score.
